units.source_text: 到了十月里，薰君于初五六日赴宇治访问。

en.t: In the tenth month, around the fifth or sixth day, Lord Kaoru went to visit Uji.

units.source_text: 从者都说：“这几天鱼梁上景致正好，请不妨去看看。”

en.t: His attendants all said, "The scenery by the fish weir is especially fine these days, so please do go and have a look."

units.source_text: 薰君说：“何必！

en.t: Lord Kaoru said, "Why should I?

units.source_text: 人生无常跟蜉蝣相差无几，鱼梁有什么好看呢？”

en.t: Human life is as fleeting as a mayfly; what is there worth seeing at a fish weir?"

units.source_text: 路上风景一概不看。

en.t: He paid no attention at all to the scenery along the road.

units.source_text: 他乘坐一辆轻便的竹帘车，身穿厚绸常礼服和新制的裙子，故意装得简单朴素。

en.t: He rode in a light carriage with bamboo blinds, wearing an everyday robe of thick silk and newly made trousers, deliberately presenting himself in a simple, plain style.

units.source_text: 八亲王竭诚欢迎，办起山乡式的筵席来招待他，也颇富有风趣。

en.t: The Eighth Prince welcomed him wholeheartedly and entertained him with a rustic mountain-village banquet, which had a charm of its own.

units.source_text: 日色既暮，将灯火移近，研读最近所习的经文。

en.t: When evening fell, they drew the lamps closer and studied the scriptures they had recently been learning.

units.source_text: 特邀阿阇梨下山，请他解释深奥的教义。

en.t: They specially invited the ajari down from the mountain and asked him to explain the profound doctrines.

units.source_text: 晚上不能睡觉，因为川上狂风大作，木叶散落之声、水波冲击之音，竟超过哀愁之上，使环境变得凄厉可怕。

en.t: That night sleep was impossible, for a fierce wind raged upstream, and the sounds of falling leaves and beating waves went beyond melancholy, making the whole place grim and terrifying.

units.source_text: 薰君估量天色将近黎明，回想起上次破晓听琴之事，便提出琴音感人最深等话，对八亲王说：“上次造访，于浓雾弥漫的拂晓，隐约听到女公子弹出几声美妙的琴声。

en.t: Lord Kaoru judged that dawn was near, remembered the time he had heard music at daybreak on his previous visit, and, after saying how deeply moving the sound of the koto could be, told the Eighth Prince, "When I visited last time, at a mist-filled dawn, I faintly heard the young ladies play several beautiful notes.

units.source_text: 未能继续听赏，反有不足之憾。”

en.t: Because I could not go on listening, I was left all the more regretful."

units.source_text: 八亲王答道：“我已屏除声色，从前学得的都忘记了。”

en.t: The Eighth Prince replied, "I have cast aside music and worldly pleasures, and I have forgotten everything I once learned."

units.source_text: 但还是召唤侍者将琴取来，说道：“要我弹琴，实在太不相称了。

en.t: Even so, he called an attendant to bring the koto and said, "It is really quite unsuitable for me to play.

units.source_text: 须得你引导一下，我才回想得出来。”

en.t: Only if you guide me a little will I be able to remember."

units.source_text: 便命取琵琶来，劝客人弹奏。

en.t: He then had a biwa brought and urged his guest to play.

units.source_text: 薰君就弹琵琶，和他合奏了一会，说道：“我上次隐约听到的，似乎不是这把琵琶的声音。

en.t: Lord Kaoru played the biwa and joined him for a while, then said, "What I faintly heard last time does not seem to have been the sound of this biwa.

units.source_text: 恐怕那把琵琶音色与众不同，所以声音特别优美吧。”

en.t: Perhaps that other biwa had an unusual tone, and that is why it sounded especially beautiful."

units.source_text: 兴致阑珊起来，便不再弹下去。

en.t: His interest faded, and he stopped playing.

units.source_text: 八亲王说：“噫，此言差矣！

en.t: The Eighth Prince said, "Ah, you are mistaken there!

units.source_text: 能使你中听的技法，怎么会传到这种山乡地方来呢？

en.t: How could a technique pleasing to your ear ever have reached such a mountain village as this?

units.source_text: 你的夸奖太失当了。”

en.t: Your praise is far too misplaced."

units.source_text: 他就弹起七弦琴来，其音哀怨凄凉，沁人心肺。

en.t: He then began to play the seven-stringed koto, and its sound was mournful and desolate, piercing deeply into the heart.

units.source_text: 半是山中松风之声所使然吧。

en.t: Perhaps half of that effect came from the sound of the pines in the mountain wind.

units.source_text: 八亲王表示久已遗忘、非常生疏的样子，只弹了饶有趣味的一曲，便罢手了。

en.t: The Eighth Prince acted as though he had long forgotten and was very out of practice, and after playing just one engaging piece, he stopped.

units.source_text: 他说：“我家里也有人弹筝，不知几时学得的。

en.t: He said, "There is someone in my house who plays the zheng too, though I do not know when she learned it.

units.source_text: 我常隐约听到，似觉弹者略有心得。

en.t: I often hear it faintly, and the player seems to have some understanding of the instrument.

units.source_text: 但我长久不曾加以督促。

en.t: But I have not supervised her for a long time.

units.source_text: 不过是任意乱弹而已，不成体例，只能和川中波声合奏。

en.t: She merely plays at random as she pleases, with no proper form, and can only accompany the sound of the river waves.

units.source_text: 反正不成腔调，不中听的。”

en.t: In any case, it has no real melody and is unpleasant to hear."

units.source_text: 便对里面的女公子说：“弹一曲吧！”

en.t: Then he said to the young ladies within, "Play one piece."

units.source_text: 女公子答道：“我们原是私下玩玩的，想不到被人听见，已经羞死，岂可公然显丑呢？”

en.t: The young ladies replied, "We were only amusing ourselves in private; to think that someone heard us is already mortifying, so how could we openly display our poor playing?"

units.source_text: 就躲进里面，都不肯弹。

en.t: They withdrew farther inside, and none of them would play.

units.source_text: 父亲屡次劝勉，她们用种种借口拒绝，终于不弹。

en.t: Their father urged them again and again, but they refused with various excuses and in the end did not play.

units.source_text: 薰君大失所望。

en.t: Lord Kaoru was deeply disappointed.

units.source_text: 此时八亲王暗想：“把两个女儿抚养成如此古怪而不见世面的乡下姑娘，这原非我的本意。”

en.t: At this, the Eighth Prince thought to himself, "It was never my intention to raise my two daughters into such strange, sheltered country girls."

units.source_text: 他觉得可耻，对薰君说：“我在此抚育两女，谁也不让知道。

en.t: Feeling ashamed, he said to Lord Kaoru, "I have brought up my two daughters here without letting anyone know.

units.source_text: 但我余命不多，旦夕难保。

en.t: But I have little life left, and I may not last even from morning to evening.

units.source_text: 这两人来日方长，深恐她们将来颠沛流离。

en.t: These two still have long lives ahead of them, and I deeply fear that they may one day be left to wander in hardship.

units.source_text: 只此一事，是我离世时往生极乐的羁绊。”

en.t: This one concern alone is the attachment that will bind me when I leave this world and seek rebirth in paradise."

units.source_text: 此言十分诚恳，使薰君深感同情，答道：“我虽不能正式担任有力之保护人，但可请您视我为亲信之人。

en.t: These words were so sincere that Lord Kaoru was deeply moved, and he answered, "Although I cannot formally serve as a powerful guardian, please consider me someone you can trust.

units.source_text: 只要我的世寿稍得延长，则一言既出，驷马难追，决不辜负尊嘱。”

en.t: So long as my life is extended even a little, once I have given my word it cannot be taken back, and I will never betray your honored request."

units.source_text: 八亲王心甚感谢，答道：“但得如此，不胜欣幸！”

en.t: The Eighth Prince was deeply grateful and replied, "If that is so, I could not be more fortunate!"
